record.question: Who is the Minister in Charge of the Ministry of North Eastern Region in the Modi 2.0 government?
record.explanation: Answer A: Jitendra Singh. Dr. Jitendra Singh held independent charge of the Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region in the 2019 Council of Ministers. Reference: https://www.pmindia.gov.in/en/assets-and-liabilities-of-the-union-council-of-ministers-2018-2019-as-on-30-03-2019/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
